sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by pre-permeabilization HA immunolabeling in polarized MDCK cells (L5). Trafficking and apical/basolateral distribution studied (L2). Channel electrophysiology of the HA-tagged construct is NOT MEASURED in any ledger clip.
sites.rationale: L4 explicitly names the insertion loop ('short luminal loop between L and M α-helices') and notes it carries an N-linked glycan, uniquely identifying EC3 (residues 385–430) in the provided topology landmarks — the only extracellular loop with an N-glycosylation sequon (NRT at N403, computed from the canonical sequence). No ledger clip specifies a residue number, so insert_after_residue is null and the site is loop-level. L5 confirms surface display by pre-permeabilization antibody labeling, establishing surface_only validation. The loop is 46 residues long and ≥3 residues from both flanking TM boundaries (TM5 ends at 384, TM6 starts at 431), providing ample space for a 15–23 aa ALFA tag with GS linkers. Full-length human CLC-2 stably expressed in MDCK cells with a hemagglutinin (HA) epitope tag inserted into the short luminal loop between helices L and M (EC3, residues 385–430 per topology landmarks). The loop contains an N-linked glycan at N403 (NRT sequon), confirming extracellular placement. The same construct was delivered in vivo via lentivirus into CLC-2-KO mice. No ledger clip names a specific residue number; the position is loop-level only.

sources.claim: The HA epitope is located in the short luminal loop between L and M α-helices; this loop contains an N-linked glycan.

literature_notes: All six ledger clips (L1–L6) describe the same HA-tagged CLC-2 construct originating from the Cid/Sepulveda laboratory. L3 and L4 are the most informative, naming the 'short luminal loop between L and M α-helices' as the tag location and noting the N-linked glycan in that loop. Computed from the canonical sequence, the only extracellular loop with an N-glycosylation sequon (NxS/T, x≠P) is EC3 (385–430) at N403 (NRT), confirming the loop identity. EC1 (115–133) also has an NTS sequon at N127 but is not the L-M loop by CLC helix nomenclature. No ledger clip names a specific residue, so the site cannot be promoted to 'validated'; it remains a loop-level (topology_derived) site. The other extracellular spans — EC2 (296–317, 22 aa), EC4 (471, 1 aa), EC5 (542, 1 aa) — have no ledger support for tag insertion and are not proposed.
